description: Make a customer hub link: one page where this customer sees their quotes, jobs, invoices, upcoming visits and requests with you, pays, asks to move or cancel a visit, and asks for new work. The customer must sign in with an email you have for them (the customer's email or a contact's), so a forwarded link shows nothing to anyone else. The url is shown once; send it to the customer yourself. Lasts expires_in_days (default 90, up to 365) until revoked. Owner or office only.
name: hub_createLink
